prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for a cozy illustrated browser game. Reference image: the attached dafeiyu-chibi-character-sheet.png is the character identity and art style reference. Create a single SQUARE 2048x2048 sprite sheet with a precise 2 by 2 equal grid, four separate full-body versions of the SAME chibi whale maid, one centered inside each quadrant, no grid lines. Preserve indigo-to-blue wavy long hair, huge blue eyes, fin-shaped ears with white undersides, two blue ribbon hair bows, white frilled maid headband, navy dress with gold stitching, white apron with a small blue whale emblem, navy Mary Jane shoes, blue whale tail visible beside her. Cute round tiny proportions, large head, clean illustrated linework, gentle painterly cel shading, all-ages fully clothed. Top-left: neutral friendly idle with hands relaxed, mouth tiny smile. Top-right: happily chewing with puffed cheeks, hands close to chest, eyes smiling, no food props. Bottom-left: excited delighted with eyes closed into happy curves and arms open. Bottom-right: hungry with droopy eyes and pleading hands, visibly pouty but cute. Every figure is front-facing, same body size, feet baseline 90% down its own quadrant, full hair/tail inside its quadrant, maximum figure height 82% of a cell, at least 8% transparent margins. Hands empty. Absolutely no basin, no hat beyond original headband, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text or labels, no extra mini figures. True transparent alpha around every sprite. The four grid cells must remain separate, with no overlap.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production-ready transparent game prop sprite ATLAS, landscape 4:3 aspect ratio, ideally 2048x1536, with a perfectly regular 4 COLUMN by 3 ROW grid. Each of 12 equal cells holds exactly ONE isolated centered prop, no visible grid. Match the cozy hand-painted cartoon linework of the reference whale maid: navy outlines, watercolor-like warm cream highlights, gentle cel shading, cheerful miniature farming game. Props fill at most 75% of their cell; at least 10% empty transparent margin on all sides, no overlap. Exact row-major grid: Row 1 column 1 an empty small square muddy paddy field with a blue water surface and tan earthen border, slight isometric view; row 1 column 2 the SAME field with small bright green rice seedlings; row 1 column 3 the SAME field with lush ripe golden rice stalks; row 1 column 4 a tied bundle of harvested golden paddy. Row 2 column 1 an open cream cloth sack of dry WHITE uncooked rice grains; row 2 column 2 a cute small blue-and-cream wooden rice milling machine with hopper and wheel; row 2 column 3 a pale blue rice cooker with closed cream lid, no steam; row 2 column 4 the SAME cooker open with steaming fluffy white rice. Row 3 column 1 a broad EMPTY shallow silvery iron washbasin, open upward in three-quarter view; row 3 column 2 the SAME silver washbasin filled with a large mound of fluffy COOKED WHITE RICE and little steam curls; row 3 column 3 the SAME silver basin UPSIDE DOWN like a round metal helmet, broad rim at bottom, dome rising upward, no character beneath it; row 3 column 4 three large simple ivory cooked rice grains as one small icon. Crucial the empty basin and filled basin are the same width and shape, and white rice reads as white rice rather than yellow rice. No characters, no text, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no ground, no framing boxes, no backdrop, TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha. This is a consistent usable asset atlas, not a concept board.

packaging: Original RGBA atlases preserved. Equal-cell cropping, margin separation and tight-alpha basin crops only. No artwork redrawn by packaging.
